changeSummary: Removed all drop-cap styling while preserving the fifteen-page causal narrative.
Added shared display, body and utility type roles with tested Korean glyph fallback.
Added candidate typography responsibilities for the writer, designer and independent validator.

combinedEvidenceBinding.algorithm: sha256 over UTF-8 canonical JSON containing revision, sourceReviewEvidence and visualAndWritingEvidence, with recursively sorted object keys, arrays preserved and a trailing newline

recommendedUse.writing: Begin from the reader's problem and a transferable system principle, then introduce framework and implementation vocabulary as evidence.
recommendedUse.narrative: Follow one request through event, snapshot, context, generator, stream, effect and recovery.
recommendedUse.design: Use Systems Monograph for explanatory progress and Evidence Notebook for claim review; select a page mode by content function.
recommendedUse.typography: Keep paragraph openings at the body size, apply shared type roles and never rely on capitalization, size or color alone to carry meaning.
recommendedUse.quality: Hold the candidate when argument, hierarchy or evidence depends on keywords, badges, disconnected cards, drop caps or page-local font overrides.
